provenance: Hand-authored flat-FOND miniature (ticket fond-htn-06-diff-flatfond, 2026-09-17). Tireworld family of the nondeterministic-planning literature (tireworld as FOND/contingent benchmark: Hoffmann & Brafman, JAIR 2006; strong-cyclic treatment: Cimatti, Pistore, Roveri & Traverso, AIJ 2003). No koala files used.
literature_ref: Cimatti, Pistore, Roveri, Traverso, 'Weak, Strong, and Strong Cyclic Planning via Symbolic Model Checking', AIJ 147 (2003); Hoffmann & Brafman, JAIR 26 (2006)
class_rationale: Every drive may flatten the tire; recovery (change-tire) returns to the same driving state, so no acyclic strong policy exists, but the retry loop reaches the goal under fairness.
